in_marathi.name: Gajanan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gajanan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gajanan is a name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘gajanaan,’ which translates to ‘elephant-faced.’ In Hindu mythology, Gajanan is another name for Lord Ganesha, who is the god of wisdom, new beginnings, and success. vedic_reference.note: Gajanana is a form of Lord Ganesha. He is also known as Vighnaraja, the remover of obstacles. The name Gajanana comes from the word 'gaja', meaning elephant, and 'anana', meaning one who has thousand eyes.
